title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 31: Science and technology (Set 1)

lessons.title: nhúng từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng học các từ vựng thuộc chủ điểm Science and technology (Set 1) ngay nhé!

Nhấn ᐸ / ᐳ để chuyển sang từ khác và 🔊 để nghe phát âm.

Bạn nên đọc kĩ nghĩa, ví dụ và nghe phát âm của tất cả các từ vựng trước khi nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang luyện tập ở mức nhận biết.

lessons.title: học từ
lessons.contentHtml:
Hãy cùng luyện tập các từ vựng bạn vừa học nhé!

(Nhấn "Next" để chuyển sang các bài tập tiếp theo.)

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Science and technology (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Complete the sentences, using the hints given. The 1.1 uses advanced technology to make checking-in faster and more efficient. Scientists use a 1.2 to check bones and find problems inside the human body. Some smartphones use a 1.3 to unlock the screen instead of a password. Scientists are working hard to protect our 1.4 from the effects of climate change.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng chủ điểm Science and technology (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Read the conversation and then choose the correct answer to fill in each blank. Linh: Hi Nam! Have you heard about the new 15.1 biometric magnetic  security system at the airport? Nam: Yes! It helps check a person’s 15.2 identity characteristic using fingerprints or facial scans. Linh: That’s so cool! And when you go to the stalls in the airport, you don't need cash or a card to buy things. Many banks use 15.3 digital national banking such as mobile banking or online banking to make payments easier. Nam: Right! They just use a(n) 15.4 application game on their phone. Linh: Technology is amazing! Scientists always create new ways to make life more convenient. Nam: Yes! I wonder what new inventions we will see in the future.

vocabTable.meaning: từ vựng thuộc bài Science and technology (Set 1)
vocabTable.example: Drag and drop to complete the text. Technology is changing our lives in many ways. At the 16.1 , security checks are now faster because of new machines. A 16.2 can quickly check luggage, and 16.3 systems use fingerprints or facial scans to confirm a person’s identity. This helps make travel safer and more 16.4 . In daily life, technology also helps people communicate, work, and learn. A great 16.5 is the smartphone, which allows people to call, message, and search for information easily. Students can also use smart devices to study online and improve their skills. Many 16.6 scientists and engineers work hard to create new technology. Their ideas help make life easier and better for everyone. Science and technology continue to improve the world every day.
